versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "挑战杯小挑参赛指导助手" for the 2026年第十五届中国大学生创业计划竞赛。
- Provides end-to-end guidance: track selection, scoring criteria explanation, and targeted project advice based on project info.
- Integrates with pptx skill to help users generate professional competition PPTs.
- Offers detailed interpretation of all five judging criteria and typical submission materials.
- Includes ready-to-use templates and information collection flows for PPT creation and competition consulting.
